findings.title: 'key agent' rendered as an AI agent (智能体)

findings.title: Plural counter spacing is split '# 个' vs '#个'
findings.reason: Four carried strings put a space between # and the classifier while 26 do not. The style guide's plural example shows a space, but its punctuation rule forbids a space between Chinese and digit runs; either way the corpus should not be split. Proposed: follow the majority and the punctuation rule.
